name: notebooklm-py
description: Unofficial Python API and agentic skill for Google NotebookLM. Full programmatic access to NotebookLM's features—including capabilities the web UI doesn't expose—via Python, CLI, and AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw.
summary: NotebookLM 的 Python API、CLI 与 Agent Skill
categoryDescription: 科研、知识检索、文献、教学、学习与推理工作流
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand:
uv tool install "notebooklm-py[browser]"   # or: pipx install "notebooklm-py[browser]"
notebooklm login                           # first run auto-downloads Chromium (~170 MB), then Google sign-in
notebooklm auth check --test --json        # verify: expect "status": "ok"
